system: Wild & Wandering PMS & Channel Manager Engine

architecture.css_rule: 100% of styles reside in style.css. Inline <style> blocks are prohibited.
architecture.channex_rule: channex.js is certified under strict rate limits (<= 18 ARI calls/min). Its implementation is read-only.
architecture.zero_shim_rule: NEVER write fuzzy regex fallbacks or name shims. Fix caller signatures directly.
